criterion: which entity type the entity named at the end of the text ("The entity type of X") belongs to

categories.name: Person
categories.definition: An individual human being.

categories.name: Location - Geographic Feature
categories.definition: A natural landform, body of water, or celestial body (e.g., mountain, island, sea, galaxy, star).

categories.name: Location - Administrative Division
categories.definition: A defined political or administrative area (e.g., city, country, state, region, district).

categories.name: Organization - Commercial
categories.definition: A business entity (e.g., company, airline, record label, stock exchange).

categories.name: Organization - Government/Public
categories.definition: An official group, assembly, or agency that makes laws, governs, or provides public services (e.g., legislature, library, research institution).

categories.name: Organization - Educational
categories.definition: An institution dedicated to education (e.g., university, school).

categories.name: Organization - Religious
categories.definition: An organization or group dedicated to religious purposes (e.g., church, religious group).

categories.name: Organization - Political
categories.definition: A group that seeks to achieve and maintain political power (e.g., political party).

categories.name: Organization - Military
categories.definition: A structured group within an armed force (e.g., military unit).

categories.name: Organization - Sports
categories.definition: An organized group of athletes competing in a sport, or a league/division (e.g., sports team, sports league).

categories.name: Organization - Media/Entertainment
categories.definition: A group or entity involved in music, film, television, or other forms of entertainment (e.g., music group, TV channel).

categories.name: Event - Sports
categories.definition: An organized contest or series of contests in a sport (e.g., championship, marathon).

categories.name: Event - Historical/Political
categories.definition: A significant occurrence in the past, often a political process or military conflict (e.g., election, battle).

categories.name: Product - Vehicle/Machine
categories.definition: A specific type or design of a vehicle or machine (e.g., aircraft, car, missile system).

categories.name: Product - Software/Digital
categories.definition: A program, website, or digital game (e.g., game engine, programming language, video game).

categories.name: Product - Media/Artistic Work
categories.definition: A film, book, album, song, TV show, or other artistic creation (e.g., movie, novel, musical album).

categories.name: Product - Chemical/Biological Entity
categories.definition: A chemical compound, molecule, drug, or biological entity (e.g., gene, protein, plant species, animal species).

categories.name: Product - Food/Beverage
categories.definition: A specific type of food or drink (e.g., grape variety, alcoholic drink).

categories.name: Product - Other Manufactured Good
categories.definition: Any other manufactured item not covered by other product categories (e.g., computer hardware).

categories.name: Infrastructure
categories.definition: A large-scale public system or structure (e.g., road, railway line, airport, tunnel).

categories.name: Building/Venue
categories.definition: A specific named structure or place where events are held (e.g., hotel, theatre, hospital, amusement park).

categories.name: Concept - Abstract
categories.definition: A general idea, category, or academic concept (e.g., award category, academic degree, legal act).

categories.name: Concept - Fictional/Mythological
categories.definition: A character, idea, or entity originating from a work of fiction or mythology (e.g., fictional character, deity).

categories.name: Concept - Linguistic/Cultural
categories.definition: A language, currency, or term referring to nationality/ethnicity (e.g., language, currency code, nationality).

categories.name: Medical Condition/Disease
categories.definition: An abnormal condition affecting an organism.
